summary: First Mining Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that Cat Lake First Nation and Lac Seul First Nation authorized the Springpole Gold Project under a Term Sheet Agreement with 35 negotiated terms covering environmental water protections, cultural safeguards, economic participation, and community healing. No financial terms are disclosed; the authorization is conditional on finalizing a binding agreement. This is a project milestone / permitting update, not a standard special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or capital restructuring.
